name: Draft replies to Google reviews using local rival ratings from Bright Data, GPT-5.6 and Slack

parameters.content:
## Draft Google review replies with the local field in view

A reply written in a vacuum reads like it was written in a vacuum. This drafts one reply per unanswered review with your own rating, your rivals' ratings and what those rivals actually get praised for already in front of the model.

### How it works

Each morning it reads your Google Business Profile reviews and keeps the ones with no reply yet. A review with no `reviewReply` is unanswered, so that is the whole state: nothing is logged to decide what to answer, and the same review cannot be answered twice.

If there is nothing to answer it stops there and stays quiet, without spending a single Bright Data call.

Otherwise Bright Data runs one Google Maps discovery for your category in your city and returns the local field: each rival's rating, review count, star spread and eight of their real reviews. A code step turns that into where you sit against them and what they get praised for.

A model then writes one reply per review with that context, and flags anything a human should handle personally.

Drafts go to a Google Sheet and to Slack. With `auto_reply` on, the ones that are not flagged are posted to Google as well.

### Setup

1. Google Business Profile credential, then put your account and location in **Settings**.

2. Bright Data: a Web Scraper API key. Set `business_category` and `city` the way you would type them into Google Maps.

3. Google Sheets and Slack credentials.

4. Leave `auto_reply` off until you have read a few runs of drafts.

### Customize
Optional add-ons sit unwired beside the main chain: mail an owner the 1-star reviews, translate a reply before it posts, or ping Telegram instead of Slack.

## 1. What still needs an answer
Reviews come from your Business Profile. A review with no reply yet is the whole state this needs, so nothing can be answered twice.

## 2. The local field
One Bright Data discovery for your category and city. It measured two minutes, so this polls the snapshot until the rivals are ready.

## 3. Where you sit
Rival ratings, review counts and what their happiest customers actually say, turned into the context the model writes each reply with.

## 4. Check every draft
Guardrails run here, and the digest is built before anything is published so it reports the holds too.

## 5. Log, then publish the safe ones
Every draft is logged. Only the ones that cleared the guardrails ever reach Google.

## Optional add-ons
Not wired up. Mail an owner the 1-star reviews, translate a reply, or ping Telegram.

## auto_reply posts in public

With it on, replies go straight onto your Google listing under your name. Anything the model flags for a human is still held back, but read a few runs of drafts before you switch it on.
